_comment: biffo-template#1923 — the single source of truth for every LITERAL (not
per-sibling) CloudFront path pattern this distribution routes. main.tf
and the CloudFront Function templates in this directory read this file
rather than repeating these values, so the behaviour, the function code
and the guard that checks them agree by construction instead of by
convention (#1362/#1364's remedy for #1503's three-repo seam).
Per-sibling patterns (var.sibling_origins) are deliberately NOT rows
here — they are genuinely per-instance data, not a fixed contract, and
'admin'/'login'/'c' are already reserved against them (variables.tf).
Fields:
key                 stable identifier main.tf looks this row up by.
Never rendered to AWS; changing it has no effect
on the deployed distribution as long as main.tf's
own lookups (see path_contract_gate in main.tf)
use the same key.
path_pattern        the PUBLIC CloudFront path pattern a viewer
request must match.
origin              which backend the pattern routes to: 'portal'
(the S3 portal bucket), 'plugin-host' (the
shared plugin API Gateway, ADR-0021) or
'core-api' (the Core API Gateway).
origin_path_prefix  literal prefix spliced onto the viewer path
before it reaches the origin, or '' when the
viewer path is forwarded unchanged. Only 'click'
below has one today; it drives click-rewrite.js's
generated prefix directly (main.tf templatefile).
token_required      true when the path pattern carries an opaque,
unvalidated token segment that any associated
CloudFront Function must pass through untouched
(biffo-plugin-marketing#52's constant-404 property).
function            which CloudFront Function (if any) is associated
as this behaviour's viewer-request handler:
'rewrite' (rewrite.js — Next.js static-export
routing, applies uniformly to any URI so it takes
no contract-derived data), 'click-rewrite'
(click-rewrite.js.tftpl — templated from this
row's origin_path_prefix) or 'none'.
